test-runner.description: Runs project tests (vitest for frontend, cargo test for Rust), reports failures in a structured format without modifying code

code-reviewer.description: Reviews code quality, runs typecheck (vue-tsc) and lint, reports issues in a structured format without modifying code

code-fixer.description: Reads test failure or review reports and fixes code accordingly. Re-runs tests/checks after fixing to verify the fix works

log-keeper.description: Maintains CHANGELOG.md and development logs. Records what was changed, why, and by which step in the workflow. Reads git diff and writes structured log entries
